decisions.reason: The supplement range builds on the firm's established consumer health offer and has its own web page, so results likely meet aspirations, and the large firm's slack lets it carry the line while results mature.
The skin and hair supplement fits the firm's pharmacy channel and was actively promoted as new, so there is no clear shortfall that would trigger problemistic search after only one year.
The joint health supplement extends the established Trivital brand at low cost, and its uncertain early results can be carried with the slack of a large firm.

The mushroom-based immune supplement is a more niche product with only a mention on the website, which makes a shortfall somewhat more likely, but one year is too short to drop it given low carrying costs.
A generic blood pressure drug sits within the firm's broad generics range, and its regulatory approval is a sunk investment, so it would likely be kept unless margins fall clearly below aspirations.
